Maharashtra Forms Committee to Reform Exam and Recruitment Processes

The Maharashtra government has established a seven-member high-level committee to reform the state's examination and recruitment systems, aiming to enhance transparency and security. The committee will oversee changes from the examination process through to the declaration of results. The formation of this committee follows concerns about the integrity of recruitment procedures in the state.
